title: Move a wafer onto a hotplate with a transfer paddle, never touching its top
instruction: Using the transfer paddle, carry the wafer from its pedestal to the hotplate and leave it inside the white ring. Never touch the wafer's top or the hotplate's top.
context: In semiconductor and MEMS labs a wafer's top is never touched and a hotplate's top is too hot to touch, so wafers are moved on a PTFE paddle: slid onto it off a pedestal by the rim, and slid off its front edge onto the plate.
setup: Station table (top 0.7475 m). Robot base frame: x forward, y to the robots' left. A steel pedestal at (0.24, -0.10): a 30 mm diameter column 8 cm tall on a 6 x 6 x 0.6 cm base. On it, centred and top up, a 4-inch silicon wafer: 101.6 mm across, 1 mm thick, 10 g, overhanging the column by 36 mm all round. A white PTFE transfer paddle, 60 g, lies flat on the table with its plate centred at (0.20, 0.07): a plate 110 mm wide (x) by 115 mm long (y) by 3 mm thick, open along its front edge (-y), with 3 x 3 mm lips along both sides, a 5 mm high stop along its back edge, and a 12 x 70 x 10 mm handle running back (+y) from a riser behind the stop, its top 25 mm above the plate's underside, ending in a red tab 30 x 10 x 30 mm that rises 2 cm above the handle. An aluminium hotplate block, 16 x 16 x 4 cm, centred at (0.355, -0.02), with a black control panel and a red lamp on its front (-x) face. On its top plate, a ring of 24 white dots, 4 mm across, their inner edges 4 mm outside the rim of a wafer centred on the plate. Fixed layout matching the screenshot.
scoring: Measured at the end. 0 if at any time: a fingertip came within 6 mm above the wafer's top, more than 3 mm inside its rim (top touched); the wafer tilted past 40 degrees or fell below 2 cm above the table (dropped); a fingertip came within 4 mm of the hotplate's top, over it; or the wafer was at once off the pedestal, off the paddle (its centre over the plate, within 9 mm of its top) and not over the hotplate (within 15 mm of its top), i.e. held by a hand. Otherwise: 1.0 if the wafer lies flat (within 2 degrees) on the hotplate's top, its centre within 3 mm of the ring's centre, with both hands at least 5 cm from it; 0.5 if it rests on the hotplate otherwise; 0.25 if it was carried on the paddle at least 4 cm from the pedestal; 0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Put the wafer back on the pedestal, centred and top up, and the paddle back on the table as in the screenshot.
fidelity: PhysX at 240 Hz. The wafer is a rigid disc drawn 1 mm thick (real 0.525 mm) with its real 10 g mass; it never flexes, chips or breaks. Friction: PTFE 0.10, wafer 0.15, hotplate 0.8, pairs averaged; the wafer's slide off the paddle's edge depends on them. The hotplate is not heated: touching its top is scored, not felt. Contamination of the wafer's top is scored from fingertip position, not contact.
